{"webinar_flag":"true","geo":"NA","intent":"hot"}
jordan: I can add hidden inputs and POST to /hooks/lead-route. Will share a curl test.

webhook-bot: Reminder: update Marketo mapping & staging webhook before 09:00 tomorrow.
maya: Hero lines draft: 1) "Predictable serving economics for production LLMs" 2) "Unified serving: hosted → dedicated → private" — I'll assemble the one-pager and drop for review at 4:30. If no blockers, ship to SDRs tomorrow AM. :rocket:
